title: WineDB: Fine Wine Vintages & Blends (Sample)
subtitle: Wineries, wines, vintages, varietal blend percentages and tasting descriptors
description:
# 🍷 WineDB — Fine Wine & Vintages Sample Dataset

> **Full dataset:** [winedb.dataengineered.io](https://winedb.dataengineered.io/) · **$49 one-time** → [Buy on Stripe](https://buy.stripe.com/bJe8wQf3GdrobDZ0A038407) · the same sample on [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Ichlibitiche/winedb-fine-wines-and-vintages)
A **free sample** of the WineDB dataset: normalized relational tables of fine wine producers, cuvees, vintages, varietal blend percentages (`SUM <= 100.001`, enforced by SQLite triggers), alcohol content (ABV %) and organoleptic tasting descriptors. The sample's `vintages.csv` has 11 of the full snapshot's 17 columns; the [data dictionary](https://github.com/WhiskyyDB/wine-database/blob/main/DATA_DICTIONARY.md) explains how each field is made. Prefer SQLite? The same sample ships as a relational `winedb.sqlite` (foreign keys + blend-sum triggers) on [the WineDB site](https://winedb.dataengineered.io/) and [GitHub](https://github.com/WhiskyyDB/wine-database/blob/main/samples/winedb.sqlite).

## What's in this sample

| File | Rows | What it shows |
| :--- | ---: | :--- |
| `wineries.csv` | 26 | Producers with country, region, founded year + source URL |
| `wines.csv` | 27 | Wine cuvees with type and appellation |
| `vintages.csv` | 59 | Vintage rows: ABV, bottle volume, aging regime, cases produced, release price, source URL |
| `blends.csv` | 171 | Varietal composition percentages per vintage |
| `tasting_profiles.csv` | 236 | Organoleptic aromatic and palate descriptors |
| `appellations.csv` | 27 | Appellations (geographical indications) |

## The full dataset

- **3,675 vintage records** across **106 winery records** and 57 appellations
- `data_sources` table (3,746 rows)
- 3NF relational `winedb.sqlite`, SQL dump, 7 CSV and 7 JSON exports, refreshed monthly
- Data dictionary for every table and column, including how its values are made

**→ Get it at [winedb.dataengineered.io](https://winedb.dataengineered.io/)** · [GitHub: WhiskyyDB/wine-database](https://github.com/WhiskyyDB/wine-database) · [Data dictionary](https://github.com/WhiskyyDB/wine-database/blob/main/DATA_DICTIONARY.md) · [Sources](https://github.com/WhiskyyDB/wine-database/blob/main/SOURCES.md)

## Use cases

- Wine list & hospitality software prototypes (producer/cuvee/vintage names, ABV, bottle specs)
- Teaching relational schema design: six normalized, join-ready tables

resources.description: 26 fine-wine producers: winery_id, name, country, region, founded_year, source_url.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Producer name (e.g. Chateau Margaux, Opus One Winery).

fields.name: region
fields.description: Wine region / sub-region (e.g. Napa Valley, Pauillac).

fields.name: founded_year
fields.description: Year the winery was founded, as entered; empty when not entered.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Source URL cited when the row was entered by hand; not re-checked.

resources.description: 27 cuvees: wine_id, winery_name, name, wine_type, appellation_name.

fields.name: winery_name
fields.description: Producer name (denormalized join key to wineries).

fields.name: wine_type
fields.description: Style classification: Red, White, Sparkling, Sweet/Fortified.

resources.description: 59 vintage releases: vintage_year, abv_percent, bottle_volume_ml, aging_regime, production_cases, release_price_usd, valuation_index_usd, source_url.

fields.name: aging_regime
fields.description: Oak/aging program, as entered; empty when unstated.

fields.name: production_cases
fields.description: Cases produced; empty when not disclosed.

fields.name: release_price_usd
fields.description: Release price in USD; empty when not published.

fields.name: valuation_index_usd
fields.description: Valuation index (USD); empty on every row of this sample.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Source URL cited when the row was entered by hand; not re-checked.

resources.description: 171 varietal blend rows: percent per variety per vintage (sums to <= 100.001 per vintage).

fields.name: percent
fields.description: Share of the variety in the blend (%); per-vintage sum <= 100.001 (trigger-enforced).

fields.name: descriptor
fields.description: Organoleptic descriptor (aroma/palate), e.g. Black currant, Graphite.

resources.description: 27 geographical indications: name, country, classification, parent_region.

fields.name: classification
fields.description: Legal scheme: AOC, DOCG, AVA, etc.; empty when unclassified.

fields.name: parent_region
fields.description: Parent region, as entered; empty for top-level.
